headline: No votes were taken; speakers from advocacy groups and a school union outlined 2027 legislative priorities, including school funding and behavioral health.
summary: No votes were taken. Guests from social work, children's, teachers' and school board groups described their 2027 legislative priorities. Residents also gave public comment.
discussion: Medicaid funds for schools: Speakers said Maine leaves millions of federal dollars unclaimed because districts find it hard to bill MaineCare for services.
State education funding: Speakers asked the state to keep its 55% share of school funding and to fix transportation and special education funding.
Behavioral health access: Speakers said many people still cannot get basic behavioral health care, and that the term covers mental health and substance use.
Early childhood and pre-K: Speakers described limits on early intervention eligibility and a push toward full-day pre-K programs.
School construction and repairs: Speakers said aging school buildings affect student learning and called for more repair and construction funding.
